PM Modi uses popular meme phrase in Gujarat speech

Prime Minister Narendra Modi incorporated the popular internet meme phrase "Sun rahe ho na Vinod" into a speech delivered in Gujarat. The inclusion of the phrase elicited laughter and applause from the audience present at the event. This usage highlights the integration of internet culture into political communication.
